test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active form of the given sentence.**

How his problems will be fixed by you?

options.text: How are you fixing his problems?
How will you fix his problems?

solution:
Here the correct answer is **How will you fix his problems?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **passive voice**. We need to change it into **active voice**.
 
• The subject and object will interchange their place.
 
• **'Will be fixed' **will change into** 'will fix'.**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

**Correct Active Form**__: *How will you fix his problems?*
